description: List your Crown Town Compost invoices — number, date, amount, status, whether payable, and links (Stripe PDF / receipt / hosted invoice page). Paginated. view "brief" answers one line per invoice instead ("Invoice <number> <amount> — <ISO date> — <status>", inside the untrusted-data envelope) and lists only the payable invoices unless payable_only is false. Read-only.

payable_only.description: Return only open/payable invoices, searched across your whole billing history; page/per_page/total then describe the payable invoices. Defaults to false, or to true with view "brief" (what is due).

view.description: "full" (default) returns each invoice with its links; "brief" returns one line per invoice: Invoice <number> <amount> — <ISO date or "no date"> — <status>, inside the untrusted-data envelope.

name: crowntown_list_invoices
title: List billing history (invoices)
